---
title: "Validation Rules"
---

The IR validator enforces structural correctness before any writer runs.

Every error carries a rule id, a location (section, row group, row, column), and a
message. Rule ids are the strings below, both in `Display` output (`[COL_COUNT] …`)
and when errors are serialized.

## Limits

| Rule | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | `config.table_cols` > 16,384, a section has more than 1,048,576 rows, or the table has more than 50 million cells. Checked first; the other checks are skipped when a limit is exceeded. Limits are configurable from Rust (`validate_with_limits`). |

## Structural Rules

| Rule | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `COL_COUNT` | Every row (header, data and summary) has exactly `config.table_cols` cell objects; spanned positions hold placeholders |
| `ROW_COUNT` | `thead` has `config.header_rows` rows; data rows (not summary rows) total `config.body_rows` |
| `COLSPEC_LENGTH` | `column_spec` has `config.table_cols` entries |
| `STYLE_REFS_VALID` | Every `style_id` refers to a style definition or composition |
| `FOOTNOTE_REFS_VALID` | Every `footnote_mark` refers to a defined footnote |
| `SUMMARY_REQUIRES_STUB` | A group with summary rows requires `config.stub_cols >= 1` |
| `UNKNOWN_VALUE` | A keyword field holds a value outside its allowed set (see [Keyword values](#keyword-values)) |

## Span Rules

Spans are checked per section: the header, each group's data rows, and each group's
summary rows. A span never crosses a section.

| Rule | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `SPAN_ZERO_VALUE` | `colspan` or `rowspan` is 0 |
| `SPAN_OVERFLOW_RIGHT` | `col + colspan > table_cols`: span exceeds the right edge |
| `SPAN_OVERFLOW_BOTTOM` | `row + rowspan > section rows`: span exceeds the section |
| `SPAN_OVERLAP` | Two spans claim the same `(row, col)` position |
| `SPAN_GAP` | A position is covered by no cell (a placeholder with nothing spanning over it) |
| `SPAN_PLACEHOLDER_HAS_CONTENT` | A placeholder cell has non-empty content |

## Keyword values

Keyword fields are matched ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, and the aliases
below are accepted. An unrecognized value still parses: it is kept verbatim (and
round-trips unchanged) and reported as `UNKNOWN_VALUE`, so every bad value is listed
at once. Known values are written back in their canonical spelling.

| Field | Allowed values (aliases) |
|-------|--------------------------|
| `column_spec[].align`, `text_align` | `left` (`start`), `center` (`centre`), `right` (`end`), `justify`, `char` |
| `vertical_align` | `top`, `middle`, `bottom`, `baseline`, `super`, `sub` |
| `row.role` | `column_label`, `spanner_label`, `summary_row` (`summary`), `grand_summary_row` (`grand_summary`) |
| `cell.scope` | `col`, `colgroup`, `row`, `rowgroup` |
| `config.page_break_mode` | `avoid`, `allow`, `force-between-groups` (`force_between_groups`) |
| `border.*.style` | `none`, `hidden`, `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`, `double` |
| `font_weight` | `normal`, `bold`, `bolder`, `lighter`, or a number 1–1000 (JSON string or number) |
| `font_style` | `normal`, `italic`, `oblique` |
| `text_transform` | `none`, `uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize` |
| `text_decoration` | `none`, `underline`, `overline`, `line-through` |
| `white_space` | `normal`, `nowrap`, `pre`, `pre-wrap`, `pre-line`, `break-spaces` |
| `word_break` | `normal`, `break-all`, `keep-all`, `break-word` |
| `overflow`, `config.container_overflow` | `visible`, `hidden`, `clip`, `scroll`, `auto` |
| `text_overflow` | `clip`, `ellipsis` |
| conditional `selector.row_parity` | `even`, `odd` |
| conditional `selector.scope` | `tbody` (`body`), `thead` (`head`), `table` (`all`) |
| `typed_value.type`, `cell.data_type` | `string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean`, `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `duration` (plus common aliases such as `int`, `bool`, `float`) |

## How Validation Works

The validator materializes a **2D occupancy grid** for each section:

1. Allocate a `rows × cols` grid
2. Walk every cell in document order
3. For each cell with `rowspan=R, colspan=C` at position `(r, c)`:
   - Claim all positions `(r..r+R, c..c+C)`
   - If already occupied → `SPAN_OVERLAP` error
   - If out of bounds → `SPAN_OVERFLOW_RIGHT` / `SPAN_OVERFLOW_BOTTOM` error
4. Report any position no cell covers as `SPAN_GAP`

## Error Output

Each error includes the rule name, location, and a human-readable message:

```text
[COL_COUNT] tbody group 0 row 0 has 4 cells but config.table_cols is 3
[SPAN_OVERFLOW_RIGHT] cell at (row=1, col=4) has colspan=3 but table has 5 columns
[PlaceholderHasContent] placeholder cell at (row=2, col=1) has non-empty content
```

## Usage

::: {.panel-tabset}

### CLI

```bash
gridwell validate table.json
# Exit code 0 = valid, 1 = errors found
```

### Rust

```rust
let errors = table.validate();
// errors: Vec<ValidationError>
```

### Python

```python
errors = table.validate()
# errors: list[str]
```

### R

```r
errors <- gw_validate(tbl)
# errors: character vector
```

:::
